newsitem.title: SWEDEN: STORA DECLINES COMMENT ON LEYKAM RUMOUR.
newsitem.headline: STORA DECLINES COMMENT ON LEYKAM RUMOUR.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora on Friday said it had no comment on market rumours it was interested in making a bid for KNP Leykam, Dutch KNP BT's loss-making paper unit.
"It seems that we have been caught up in this spiral of rumours around Leykam and we don't comment on principle on rumours," managing director Lars-Ake Helgesson told Reuters.
"I would like to advise people to read our strategy (published) in our latest full year report. This could indicate how interested we would be in Leykam."
In the full year report Stora said the fine paper division would continue to be important for the group, but the company also had ambitions for its newsprint and paper board units.
Strategic acquisitions were possible within priority divisions but the number of business areas would fall, it said.
Dutch paper, packaging and office equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT has this week declined to comment on possible candidates to buy its 70-percent owned paper division KNP Leykam.
Earlier, Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf said Stora would bid for KNP Leykam.
